curriculum.name: retarget_last_email
curriculum.goal: Given a person, change the most recent email so that it is addressed to that person, and return that email.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE retarget_last_email(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND_LAST EMAIL
UPDATE $v0 RECIPIENT={person}
RETURN $v0
END
